title: Bug: application crashes when exporting CSV
body:
Steps to reproduce:
1. Open a project.
2. Select Export CSV.

Expected behavior: a CSV file is downloaded.
Actual behavior: the application crashes.
Environment: Windows 11, Python 3.12.

Traceback: RuntimeError: export failed.

title: CSV export causes the application to crash
body: Exporting a CSV causes the application to crash before the file is saved.

title: Feature request: add dark mode
body: Please add support for a dark theme so the dashboard is easier to use at night. A proposed solution would be a theme toggle in settings.
